description: Measures obligation-change classification, baseline pairing, changed-value rationales, and removed-obligation detection.

baselines.summary: Agents must inspect valid identity documents and capture a biometric fingerprint.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Every agent shall inspect a valid identity document and capture a biometric fingerprint before completing enhanced verification.

baselines.summary: Institutions must report suspicious agent transactions within 48 hours.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Suspicious agent transactions shall be reported to the Financial Reporting Centre within forty-eight hours.

baselines.summary: Institutions must retain agent transaction records for five years.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Agent transaction records shall be retained for a minimum of five years.

baselines.summary: Institutions must complete agent due diligence before onboarding.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: A licensed institution shall complete and document due diligence before onboarding an agent.

baselines.summary: Institutions must submit a monthly return for unresolved agent complaints.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: A monthly return shall list agent complaints unresolved for more than five business days.

candidates.summary: Agents must verify identity documents and biometric fingerprints during enhanced verification.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Enhanced verification requires the agent to inspect a valid identity document and capture a biometric fingerprint.

candidates.summary: Institutions must report suspicious agent transactions within 24 hours.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Suspicious agent transactions shall be reported to the Financial Reporting Centre within twenty-four hours.

candidates.summary: Institutions must retain agent transaction records for seven years.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Agent transaction records shall be retained for a minimum of seven years.

candidates.summary: Agent onboarding requires completed and documented due diligence.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: No agent may be onboarded until the licensed institution has completed and documented its due diligence.

candidates.summary: Institutions must enforce daily transaction limits for each agent tier.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Each licensed institution shall enforce the daily and single-transaction limits assigned to every agent tier.

baselines.summary: Payment providers must encrypt customer data at rest.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Payment providers shall encrypt all customer data stored at rest.

baselines.summary: Payment providers must retain access logs for twelve months.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Access logs shall be retained for a minimum of twelve months.

baselines.summary: Payment providers must notify the regulator of incidents within four hours.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: A material security incident shall be reported to the regulator within four hours.

candidates.summary: Material security incidents require regulator notification no later than four hours after detection.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Providers shall notify the regulator of a material security incident within four hours of detection.

candidates.summary: Payment providers must encrypt all stored customer information.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Payment providers shall protect all customer information held at rest through encryption.

candidates.summary: Access logs must be kept for at least twelve months.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: Providers shall preserve access logs for no less than twelve months.

baselines.summary: Vendor contracts must permit bank audits on 30 days notice.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: The bank shall have a contractual audit right exercisable on thirty days notice.

baselines.summary: Critical vendors must participate in annual resilience tests.
baselines.sourceExcerpt: Every critical provider shall participate in an operational resilience test once each year.

candidates.summary: Vendor contracts must permit bank audits on 14 days notice.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: The institution shall have a contractual audit right exercisable on fourteen days notice.

candidates.summary: No critical vendor may exceed 25 percent of total critical-service spend.
candidates.sourceExcerpt: A single provider shall not account for more than twenty-five percent of critical-service expenditure.
